title: Cynthia R NDE 3097
date: July or Aug of 1983 and Feb of 1986
content: At first I heard what seemed to be a train going through my head - a brief darkness and I climbed up Golden stairs. Once I reached the top, I began floating on pink iridescent clouds. I liked that park because my head didn't feel as if it was going to explode anymore. I didn't see any of my relatives but I did see ones from the elderly couple - her sister and his brother, but they told me I couldn't stay with them that I had to go. That's when a Guide took me. I wanted to stay with them but I wasn't allowed. We ended up in what I called a library, but there were no walls, floors. But in my mind, I ran to the wall and began reading. Then the Guide flew me (about a foot off the ground) and I saw The Garden. Mary, Joseph, and Baby Jesus were there waving at me. Next, we flew over a river where tulips were alive at the bottom of the water. I could hear angels singing and the tulips sang along. Next, I saw a beautiful woman on the side standing. I wanted to go talk with her but was not allowed. The Guide then took me to a room (no walls etc.). There were around eleven people walking around in a circle pacing as if they were following the first guy. He came up to what seemed to be a glass wall and said, 'Help me.' So I tried to go there but the Guide said I was not allowed only he can save himself. Then we returned to the library. I heard Jesus speaking in the room to the side. I quickly ran to him but could not go through. I was very angry not to be allowed to be with Jesus. As I stood there, someone grabbed my wrist and when I turned my head, I saw a huge figure standing as if made up of golden energy. They don't talk, none of them did, but you can hear them in your head, you know what they are saying. I then knew the figure to be God. He was very loving yet very stern. I told him I was very angry that I couldn't go with Jesus. God said if you go through there, you cannot return. Then he asked me do you want to go there? I said yes. He then said but you cannot return. I said I don't want to stay here I just want to see Jesus. But God told me I must return to Earth. He said I will tell you two things then you decide if you want to stay. All of a sudden, I woke up in the elderly couple's kitchen. My memory was gone I didn't know anyone. The second NDE I was in a car wreck and had a head injury I passed out and plopped in the room with seven people in a circle with one of the seven as the guide. He looked at me and said what are you doing here go back it's not your time.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Heard what seemed to be a train going through my head; brief darkness; climbed up golden stairs.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Mary, Joseph, and Baby Jesus were there waving at me; later heard Jesus speaking in a room to the side.
arrival.other_being_detail: A Guide took her; later a huge figure 'made up of golden energy' identified as God.

environment.environment_other_detail: Golden stairs; pink iridescent clouds; a 'park'; a 'library' with no walls/floors; The Garden; river with 'tulips... alive at the bottom of the water'; a 'room' with no walls etc.; a 'glass wall'.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Second NDE: car wreck with head injury; first NDE cause not specified (woke up in an elderly couple's kitchen afterward).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Climbed golden stairs; floated on pink iridescent clouds; 'library'; 'The Garden'; river with singing angels and tulips; group of people pacing in a circle; heard Jesus speaking; encounter with God as golden energy.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Darkness/stairs → clouds/park → encounters → library/garden/river → group/glas wall → library/Jesus nearby → God/boundary statement → woke up; second NDE: immediately in room with seven people in a circle and told to go back.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Returned to the 'library' more than once; second NDE returned to a similar 'circle of people' setting.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Heard a train-like sound in her head; climbed 'Golden stairs'; floated on 'pink iridescent clouds'; tulips alive underwater that sang along with angels; a 'library' and 'room' with no walls/floors; a glass wall where a man said 'Help me' and was told only he could save himself.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Help me.” “I was not allowed only he can save himself.” “if you go through there, you cannot return.” “go back it's not your time.”
